title: Fire Engine Red Malibu Robe Hook - 2-Inch Wall Mount Brass Bathroom Hook With 2.64-In Projection, Contemporary Style, Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep robes and towels off the counter and within easy reach with a clean, contemporary wall-mounted hook — available in Fire Engine Red, which makes a fearless design statement, transforming functional bathroom hardware into a vibrant focal point. A bold choice for those who embrace color and personality in their space. Assembled in the USA and backed by a limited lifetime warranty, Malibu brings California-cool sophistication to designer bathroom hardware.

  • Fire Engine Red transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Get a cohesive finish story with color coordinated mounting hardware included.
  • Make it your own: available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes, including statement colors.
  • Built for real bathrooms: solid brass materials outlast die-cast zinc alternatives.

Complete your bathroom with matching pieces from the Malibu collection for a coordinated, contemporary bath accessories set.

Specs
- Product type: Robe hook (bathroom hook / towel hook)
- Collection: Malibu
- Style: Contemporary
- Material: Brass (solid brass materials)
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 2 in x 2 in x 2.64 in
- Projection: 2.64 in
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Product weight: 0.5 lb
- Assembly required: False
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
meta_description: Wall mount robe hook with a compact 2-inch size and 2.64-inch projection in brass. Malibu contemporary bathroom hook, assembled in the USA.
